manual_basis: Installed SIMLOX manual physical pp397-399 binds SubTaskResource(TID,SEQ,RID,QTY); pp407-414 describes SPECIAL resource and POINT-based ResourceAllocation. C01 v1.0.2 accepted the two-P-CREW INSPECT demand and 2/0 capacity outcomes under distinct single-point inputs. This probe selects two shared ResourceAllocation POINTs by APID while holding both rows in the same model.
controlled_delta: Accepted C01 capacity-2 parent gains two AIR_ZERO ResourceAllocation rows for P-CREW and P-OTHER, both BASE-01/RQTY0, and description. Its existing AIR_BASIC rows remain P-CREW2/P-OTHER0. The two frozen arms differ only Control.APID AIR_BASIC vs AIR_ZERO and ProblemDescription. Resource and SubTaskResource rows, station, aircraft, mission preparation, schedule, seed, horizon and report interval remain fixed. StockAllocation and MaintenanceAllocation have no authored rows.

pre_run_hypotheses.selected: If APID selects AIR_BASIC resource rows, the accepted C01 two-P-CREW result should repeat: crew acquired at h7, released h7.16667, preparation ends h7.5, mission launches h8 and succeeds h10; the first relevant ResourceResults bin should integrate 20 person-minutes.
pre_run_hypotheses.zero: If APID selects AIR_ZERO, the two-P-CREW INSPECT demand should wait with no crew lease or positive work, and the mission should cancel at an observed time. C01 capacity-0 at a single POINT cancelled near h7.58333; this is a prediction, not an acceptance assumption.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: The converter may reject duplicate RID/STID across POINTs, ignore APID, sum capacities, shift cancellation, or yield unexpected resource, preparation or mission events. Any such result remains a diagnostic until reconciled with native resource/system report bins.

limits: This is ResourceAllocation POINT/APID selection alone on a C01 preparation resource demand. It does not establish combined StockAllocation/MaintenanceAllocation selection, E01 LRU replacement, station routing or StationVariant.
One station, seed, two resource capacities and two POINTs only; general capacity behavior, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
